timeline.summary: Garruk guards the prisoners while Oko prepares to have the High King killed as a stag.
timeline.quote: he was left to guard the prisoners

timeline.summary: Will removes the hedron from Garruk; the curse runs wild and Garruk rampages, injuring Cerise and killing Cado's corrupted griffin.
timeline.quote: As the hedron was removed from Garruk, the curse ran wild, driving him into a frenzy.

timeline.summary: Oko reveals his plans and binds the adventurers in a dome of thorns, then walks off with the stag.
timeline.quote: Oko revealed his plans and created a dome of thorns to bind the adventurers

timeline.summary: Three months later Rowan and Will decide to quest for their father, joined by Titus and Cerise.
timeline.quote: Rowan and Will decide to start on a quest to find their father, and Titus and Cerise join them.

timeline.summary: Cerise removes the hedron from Garruk, freeing his will but unleashing the Chain Veil's curse.
timeline.quote: While this has the desired effect of Garruk regaining his memories and his own will, it also returns the Chain Veil 's curse to its full force.
